authenticity_review: The image adopts a classical oil painting style which masks some AI artifacts, but structural flaws remain evident. The sheep hooves are rendered as smooth stumps without cloven definition. The trumpet valves lack precise mechanical geometry, appearing soft and fused. While the lighting and composition mimic a coherent painting, the anatomical and object-level inaccuracies prevent a high authenticity score. It resembles a flawed AI generation attempting a specific art style rather than a genuine artwork or a flawless synthesis.
